results.name: two-pair-field-baseline
results.title: Baseline · two MLAG pairs, field priorities, pair A 0x2000, pair B 0x4000
results.action: Resets the data bridge on all four CHRs over management SSH with protocol-mode=rstp and bridge priority 0x2000 on pair A and 0x4000 on pair B, the field design with one priority per pair. Pair A (CHR 1 MLAG primary, CHR 2 MLAG secondary) and pair B (CHR 3 MLAG primary, CHR 4 MLAG secondary) are joined by one distributed LACP bond, mlag-id 11 on pair A and 21 on pair B. Host 1 bonds to pair B and host 2 to pair A, so both VLAN 110 streams cross both pairs. Then runs numbered 100 ms pings for 4 s in both VLAN 110 and both bypass directions and reads back bridge, MLAG, RSTP and LACP state on all four CHRs. No fault is applied.
